faqs.q: Sec. 94-36. - Cost sharing and completing the work.
faqs.a:
(a)
Except where public streets are scheduled to undergo major capital maintenance as
               defined by
section 2-291
within two years, curb, gutter and sidewalk shall be maintained on a 50/50 cost sharing
               basis whereby the property owner shall pay one-half of the reasonable cost to replace
               or repair existing curb, gutter and sidewalk and the city shall pay the other half.
               The city shall pay the entire cost of existing curb, gutter and sidewalk replacement
               or repair for public streets that are scheduled to undergo major capital maintenance
               as defined by
section 2-291
within two years. The reasonable cost shall be determined prior to March 15 of each
               year and shall be based upon the contract unit prices accepted by the city through
               a bid process or unit prices determined pursuant to
section 2-171
et seq.
(b)
The property owner may elect to hire a contractor licensed pursuant to
section 78-181
et seq. to perform the work. The property owner will be reimbursed by the city for
               half the reasonable cost, as determined by
section 94-36
(a), upon completion of the work, inspection and approval by the city, and receipt
               of a paid invoice from the contractor.
(c)
The property owner may elect, when offered by the city, to have the work performed
               by the city's contractor; however, the property owner's share of the reasonable cost
               shall either be paid prior to starting work or secured by a promissory note with interest-free
               monthly installments.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
